# Lowtide

## Locations

### Regions

- [[The Brack]] — A flat salt marsh cut by tidal channels, where the ground is mud, reeds and standing water.

### Settlements

- [[Reedholt]] — A stilt village in the deep Brack where the ferries tie up and the drowned chapel is closest.
- [[Saltwick]] — A walled port at the edge of the Brack, ruled by a Harbor Council and quietly taxed by smugglers.

### Sites

- [[Crookback Sluice]] — The great tide gate of the Compact, which no longer closes fully.
- [[Gullhook Lighthouse]] — The white lighthouse at the tip of Saltwick's mole, whose lamp has been failing on moonless nights.
- [[The Drowned Chapel]] — A bell-tower chapel from drowned Vessen that stands clear of the mud only at low water.

## NPCs

- [[Hobb Tarrow]] — Harbor Warden of Saltwick, a tired veteran who hires the Party to keep the lighthouse lit.
- [[Ilse Corran]] — Leader of the Reedrunners, a former Weir Street clerk who runs the back channels of Saltwick.
- [[Nib Ashwater]] — The goblin tally-keeper of Reedholt, who records every boat and remembers where the old ledger lies.
- [[Old Nib]] — The old goblin who counts the boats at Reedholt and keeps a tame heron.
- [[Pell Rushlight]] — A goblin ferry hand on the Marl Ferry who knows every channel and every rumor in the Brack.
- [[Sable]] — The drowned bell-ringer of Vessen, who rings the chapel bell and wants the gate opened again.

## Creatures

- [[Bandit Captain]] — A hardened crew leader who fights with scimitar and pistol and knows when to leave.
- [[Goblin Warrior]] — A small, quick fey skirmisher that hits harder with advantage and disappears after.
- [[Mire Drowner]] — A drowned dead thing that lies in silt and drags the living down by the ankle.

## Factions

- [[The Reedrunners]] — A smuggling and salvage guild that runs the back channels of the Brack and taxes Saltwick's trade.

## Deities

- [[Mother Ebb]] — The goddess of the tide, who lends the land to the living and asks for everything to be returned.

## Items

- [[Ebb Lantern]] — A brass lantern from Gullhook Lighthouse that can make shallow water and mud draw away for a minute.
- [[Harbormaster's Ledger of Vessen]] — The hidden record of Vessen's harbormaster, which proves the Compact ordered the sluice opened.

## Lore

- [[The Drowning of Vessen]] — In 271 CY the Compact opened Crookback Sluice on purpose and drowned the river city of Vessen in one night.

## House Rules

- [[Bog Ground]] — Marsh mud and silt cost extra movement and can drop a runner on their face.

## Campaigns

- [[Salt and Lantern]] — Three newcomers keep a marsh lighthouse burning and find the bell of a drowned city ringing early.

## PCs

- [[Brannoch Vell]] — A dwarf Champion fighter who guards the Party's front and searches for a missing brother.
- [[Odalys Ferro]] — A human Life cleric of Mother Ebb who wants to know why her order's shrines have no bells.
- [[Tamsin Wick]] — A halfling Thief rogue from Saltwick's Undertow who once ran errands for the Reedrunners.

## Threads

- [[Reedrunner Tithe]] — The Reedrunners squeeze the ferries and the harbor lamp, and one PC owes them a debt.
- [[The Failing Sluice]] — Crookback Sluice no longer closes fully, and the sea is creeping inland a little more each year.
- [[The Silent Bell]] — A bell rings under the water before each Long Ebb, and the drowned bell-ringer wants the truth spoken.

## Quests

- [[Keep Gullhook Lit]] — Keep the Gullhook lamp burning every night until the end of the coming Long Ebb.
